PickBits Field Invoices 0.1.0

Purpose: a single-business offline field notebook for customers, visits, invoices and history.
Apache-2.0. Zero dependencies. Static HTML/CSS/JavaScript; Node 22+ for local tools and tests.
Entry point: index.html. Deploy index.html, sw.js, manifest.webmanifest, app/ and icons/ on HTTPS.
Local: npm start. Demo: npm run demo. Only 127.0.0.1:4205; never choose another port.
Demo: ?demo=1; separate database and localStorage namespace; 25 synthetic lawn-care customers.
Core: app/core.js. Storage: app/storage.js. UI: app/ui.js. Documents: app/renderers.js.
Encryption and merge import: app/backup.js. Synthetic seeds: app/demo.js.
Storage: 64 ID-hashed IndexedDB buckets, localStorage fallback, migrations and recovery journal.
Numbers: sequential reservation, durable high-water mark, never recycle deleted numbers.
Outputs: HTML/print/PDF, canvas PNG, text; generic no-price visit summary; invoice CSV.
All customer-facing documents end with Made with PickBits Field Invoices.
Backup: optional PBKDF2-SHA256/AES-256-GCM passphrase; import adds missing IDs.
No account, telemetry, hosted API, online payments, messaging service, portal, device sync or accounting.
Private notes never appear on customer documents. Backups contain them.
Data lives on the device. Clearing site data deletes it. Recommend regular encrypted backups.
Checks: npm test; npm run preflight. Unit tests are DOM-free and never bind ports.
Optional browser checks dynamically load Playwright; missing package/engines produce explicit skips.
Read README.md and SECURITY.md. DEMO.md contains the 60-second walkthrough.
Questions and bugs: open a GitHub issue.
